'''John C. DeFries''' (born November 26, 1934) is one of the world's leading [[Behavioural genetics|behavior geneticists]]. His achievements include being President of the [[Behavior Genetics Association]] (1982–1983) and cofounder of the journal ''[[Behavior Genetics (journal)|Behavior Genetics]]'', as well as its co-editor (1970–1978). His awards include the Dobzhansky Award for Outstanding Research in Behavior Genetics ([[Behavior Genetics Association]], 1992), Consulting Editor of the ''[[Journal of Learning Disabilities]]'' (1987–2002) and fellowships in the International Academy for Research in Learning Disabilities, [[Association for Psychological Science]], and the [[American Association for the Advancement of Science]], Section J (Psychology).

His contributions include major [[twin study|twin]] and [[adoption study|adoption studies]] of [[cognitive ability|cognitive abilities]], genetics of learning disabilities, and, when molecular tools became available, pioneering the use of DNA markers to locate genes that influence behavioral characters.

At the [[Institute for Behavioral Genetics]] at the [[University of Colorado Boulder]], DeFries established the world's first large twin study of dyslexia<ref>Wadsworth SJ, DeFries JC, Olson RK, Willcutt EG (2007) Colorado longitudinal twin study of reading disability. Annals of Dyslexia, 57(2), 139-60.</ref> at the Institute for Behavior Genetics in Boulder, and  supervised over 17 PhD students.

Among his works are a standard text on behavior genetics and original work on behavior-genetic methodology, some of it in collaboration with [[David Fulker]].<ref>Alarcon, M., Plomin, R., Fulker, D.W., Corley, R. & DeFries, J.C. (1998). Multivariate path analysis of specific cognitive abilities: data at 12 years of age in the Colorado Adoption Project. ''Behavior Genetics'' '''28''': 255-264.</ref>

DeFries' articles have been cited over 29,000 times and he has an [[h-index]] of 87.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://scholar.google.co.uk/citations?user=p5CkmJ8AAAAJ&hl=en&oi=sra|title=John DeFries - Google Scholar Citations|website=scholar.google.co.uk|access-date=2016-08-15}}</ref>

==Selected books==
*''Behavioral Genetics in the Postgenomic Era'', by [[Robert Plomin]], John C. DeFries, Ian W. Craig, and Peter McGuffin
*''Behavioral Genetics'' by [[Robert Plomin]], John C. DeFries, [[Gerald E. McClearn]] and [[Peter McGuffin]].
